en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view of a town nestled in a valley surrounded by hills. The foreground features classic European architecture with large buildings, likely hotels or spa establishments, arranged in orderly rows with tree-lined streets. The background is dominated by green hills and mountains. The image is captioned in French at the bottom.
